info.name: Livestock ERP - Medicine animal type
info.description: Medicine CRUD now selects nullable animal_type_id from active animal types. Set access_token and run in order on a development database. Lookup steps capture IDs; creation captures medicine_id; final requests delete only this run's medicine. Requires medicine CRUD permissions and setup.uoms.view. Animal-type lookup is allowed for medicine view/create/update users. All requests have live saved examples. type and category still describe the medicine itself. target_animal_type text payloads and filters are prohibited.
